A mixture of lactic acid, its conden- sation products, such as lactoyl-lactic acid and other polylactic acids, and water. The equilibrium between lactic acid and poly- lactic acids depends on the concentration and temperature. It is usually the racemate (RS-lactic acid), and contains the equivalent of 88 to 92% w/w of C3H6O3. A colourless or slightly yellow, syrupy liquid. Miscible with water and with alcohol. Ph.
